items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: But this man booked this thing for us -- Don Robey is the name. And he booked us all the way down to --

ctx.x: Oh, this is (inaudible) -- you enlarged there to get a big band.

Yeah, this is the latter part of 1939. Maybe it might have been even the first of 1940. I know it was winter time. And we went down to Wichita and we'd come back, we'd play, and we'd go back to Wichita. But this man booked this thing for us -- Don Robey is the name. And he booked us all the way down to --
That's the name I said, and you laughed.
